purpose: taxids for 5 clade/species names, by exact ontology label, batch 4
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(?l, "^(Canis lupus familiaris|Exocoetus volitans|Hirundichthys speculiger|Cypselurus hiraii|Hirundichthys affinis)( <[^>]*>)?$")) }
